includeSellerRecord.description: When enabled, also emits a seller profile record for each unique seller encountered.
includeSellerRecord.title: Include Seller Record

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to extract.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Only include products priced at or below this value (in USD).
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

minPrice.description: Only include products priced at or above this value (in USD).
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

minRating.description: Only include products with an average rating at or above this value (0–5).
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

mode.description: How to find Gumroad products. Use searchProducts to search by keyword, byProductUrls to enrich specific product URLs, or bySellerUrls to scrape a seller's storefront.
mode.title: Mode

nativeTypes.description: Filter by product type. Leave empty to include all types. Allowed values: digital, course, membership, bundle, podcast, audiobook, newsletter, ticket.
nativeTypes.title: Native Types

payWhatYouWantOnly.description: When enabled, only include products that allow the buyer to set their own price.
payWhatYouWantOnly.title: Pay What You Want Only

productUrls.description: List of Gumroad product URLs to enrich (mode=byProductUrls).
productUrls.title: Product URLs

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for products (mode=searchProducts). Example: notion, python course, ebook.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sellerUrls.description: List of Gumroad seller/storefront URLs to scrape all products from (mode=bySellerUrls).
sellerUrls.title: Seller URLs

sellerVerifiedOnly.description: When enabled, only include products from verified Gumroad sellers.
sellerVerifiedOnly.title: Seller Verified Only
